body:
A registered launcher run selected with --request-message-id needs an original native message that (1) the LAUNCHING session received as its recipient, and (2) carries a TYPED testRequest. Send that testRequest with CLI `mailbox send --test-request-json '{"mode":"full","targets":[{"workRef":"w-…","use":{"kind":"committed_input","expected_commit":"<commit40>","purpose":"landing_gate"}}]}'`, or as the MCP send's testRequest object (docs/features/agent-mailboxes.md). Plain prose naming mode and commit is not a request. The runner's own outbound message (e.g. its READY to the scheduler) is refused with 409 "selected test request belongs to another native recipient or sender" (2026-11-25, Merger bfa9d8ac test-d900f09a, refused before any stage). Scheduler practice: fold the typed request into the LAUNCH NOW message under a new idempotency key, while the holder's claims are live (the host captures them at send), then give the runner that message id. A run refused at admission ran no stage and is not a gate result, so a corrected launch is not a rerun of a passed gate.

Association is captured AT SEND: each typed target needs the RECIPIENT to hold a current claim on that workRef, with a unique named source root for it, named after the claim (naming takes effect at the next turn). Otherwise every target carries uncreditedReason "association_stale: target has no unique current held claim and named root", and the run earns no credit. Before handing over the id, read the sent message back with `mailbox read-message --message-id ID --json` and check that no target has an uncreditedReason. Get the runner's "association ready" first (2026-11-25, Merger 93013530 and 574d9a08 were both stale).
